title: Source branch naming
responsibility: Combines local and remote-tracking source branches without moving local names to conflicting remote tips.

inputs.name: sourceBranches.refs
inputs.description: Listed Git refs with heads and optional symbolic targets.

inputs.name: sourceBranches.remotes
inputs.description: Configured remote names, used to disambiguate tracking prefixes by longest match.

outputs.name: sourceBranches
outputs.description: Branches sorted by name. Local branches keep their tips; a remote-only agreed tip keeps the plain branch name, while conflicting tips use remote:branch. Evidence, notes, archives, tags and remote HEAD/symbolic refs are excluded.
